formatAndSecurityRisks.risk: Draft 2020-12 requires the distinct Ajv2020 entry point. The standard Ajv formats are separate from Ajv v7+ and are supplied by ajv-formats.
formatAndSecurityRisks.mitigationGate: Import Ajv2020 explicitly, add only formats actually used by canonical schemas, and compile positive/negative fixtures for the exact generated Draft 2020-12 output.

formatAndSecurityRisks.risk: Ajv strict mode throws during schema compilation for unknown formats. ajv-formats does not implement every format: for example, IRI and IDN formats are in the separate ajv-formats-draft2019 package.
formatAndSecurityRisks.mitigationGate: Inventory format keywords in generated schemas before choosing a plugin; do not turn off strict validation just to suppress missing-format errors.

formatAndSecurityRisks.risk: Ajv's official guide warns that format implementations can contain unsafe regular expressions and recommends treating formats as potentially unsafe when validating untrusted data. Some patterns can have exponential worst-case time even on relatively short inputs; the plugin's fast mode simplifies several patterns but is not a safety guarantee.
formatAndSecurityRisks.mitigationGate: Assess each selected format against the actual input trust boundary, bound string lengths, and test hostile long inputs. Do not enable all formats without need.

formatAndSecurityRisks.risk: Ajv-formats 3.0.1 declares Ajv as both a dependency and an optional peer. Ajv warns that standalone generated validators require ajv-formats to load the same Ajv version and code as the application because of an instanceof check; package managers may retain a second Ajv copy.
formatAndSecurityRisks.mitigationGate: After dependency freeze, inspect pnpm why/lock topology and add a standalone-code fixture only if T06 uses standalone validation.

formatAndSecurityRisks.risk: Ajv 8.20.0 allows fast-uri ^3.0.1. That semver range includes releases with published host-confusion/SSRF and authority parsing advisories. The current 3.x candidate 3.1.8 is patched for the latest listed 3.x advisories as of this audit, but an old/stale lock can still select a vulnerable patch.
formatAndSecurityRisks.mitigationGate: At lock freeze verify fast-uri >=3.1.8 or an equivalent patched supported release; review its advisories again at that time. Do not assume the broad Ajv range alone forces a patched version.
